thread:
Nora (Design): quick sync3 UX tidy for the batch vectors inspector + export flow. Need to lock default collapsed rows, export CSV shape, small example headers, and a11y focus rules. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/lock-embed
Ike (Product): users rerank with source context. add opt-in "Include source text" checkbox. default collapse for >300 rows?
Jade (Eng): collapse default ok. we'll virtualize >500. for exports: CSV (floats, truncated), JSONL.gz option for large jobs, background job for >10k.
Leo (A11y): a11y notes: toggles must have aria-expanded + aria-controls; expanding moves focus into panel; announce "N vectors loaded" with aria-live polite; modal needs focus trap and Escape closes.
Maya (QA): copy mismatch: modal title says "Export embeddings" but CTA currently "Download". pick explicit CTA ("Download CSV"). test CSV parsing in Excel/Sheets and locale decimal formats.
Noah (Support): include collapsed "Show example headers" and tiny privacy hint when source_text is checked: "Source text only included in the downloaded file; handle with care."
i18n-bot: avoid concatenation, use placeholders for numbers and limits (e.g., "%d vectors").
Nora (Design): proposed copy:
- Title: "Export vectors"
- Helper: "Includes vector ids and scores. Toggle to include original source text (opt-in)."
- Checkbox: "Include original source text (opt-in)"
- Primary: "Download CSV"
- Example toggle: "Show example headers" (collapsed)
Ike (Product): add limit blurb: "Up to 10k vectors; larger exports run in background and you'll receive a link."
Jade (Eng): implementation note: default 6-decimal precision to reduce size, with advanced option for full precision. background job will emit job id and link.
Leo (A11y): also make example code block focusable and the toggle button have aria-expanded. I'll post an a11y acceptance list by EOD.
Maya (QA): I'll draft test plan: keyboard-only flow, NVDA/VoiceOver checks, parse tests, background job cancel.
Noah (Support): I'll write short modal blurb for support docs.
Nora (Design): thanks team  will update Figma and push frames. Ping here if blockers. :rocket:
